sources.core_claim: VAA-G4 (T=1/B=1), the variant the authors recommend, allocates 100% of the portfolio monthly to a single asset from an offensive universe (SPY, EFA, EEM, AGG) if all four have positive 13612W momentum, ranked by that score; if any offensive asset has negative momentum, the portfolio instead goes 100% into whichever of the defensive universe (LQD, IEF, SHY) has the highest 13612W score.

sources.core_claim: DAA-G12 (T=6, B=2) trades a 12-asset risky universe (SPY, IWM, QQQ, VGK, EWJ, VWO, VNQ, GSG, GLD, TLT, HYG, LQD) with a cash universe (SHY, IEF, LQD) and a 2-asset canary universe (VWO, BND); cash fraction CF = min(1, b/B) where b is the count of canary assets with negative 13612W momentum, and the remaining (1-CF) is split equally across the top-6 risky assets by 13612W momentum. This is TuringTrader's open-source implementation of Keller & Keuning's paper.

sources.core_claim: PAA-CPR ranks 12 global asset classes monthly by MOM=close/SMA(13 month-end closes)-1; if fewer than 7 of 12 have MOM>0, allocates the shortfall proportionally (CP%=(12-n)/6, or 100% if n<=6) to whichever of IEF/SHY has the higher MOM, holding the top-6-by-MOM equally in the remainder.

sources.core_claim: HAA uses a single canary asset (TIP); when TIP's momentum is non-positive, the whole portfolio moves to defensive bonds/cash; otherwise the offensive universe (SPY, IWM, EFA, EEM, VNQ, PDBC, IEF, TLT) is ranked by relative momentum, the top-4 are each considered for a 25% slot, and any of those 4 with non-positive own (absolute) momentum has its 25% redirected to IEF or cash.

sources.core_claim: Accelerating Dual Momentum (ADM): momentum score = sum of trailing 1, 3 and 6-month returns for each of two equity candidates (originally VFINX/VINEX, ETF proxy SPY/SCZ); if the higher score is positive, hold that equity 100%; if both are negative, hold whichever of TLT/TIP has the higher trailing 1-month return.

sources.core_claim: BAA-Balanced: if all 4 canary assets (SPY, EFA, EEM, AGG) have positive 13612W momentum, hold the top-6 of a 12-asset offensive universe by relative momentum equally weighted; else hold the top-3 of a 7-asset defensive universe (TIP, DBC, BIL, IEF, TLT, LQD, AGG) by momentum equally weighted. This exact mechanism was already screened locally in reports/research/iterations/giants_sweep_20260922/ (candidate f5_baa_balanced) under the frozen G1-G5 gate contract: anchor CAGR 9.7%, anchor Sharpe 0.49, 20bp anchor CAGR 8.5%, passing only G2 and G5, well below S3's anchor Sharpe of 1.49.
